original_benchmark.notes: Open-sourced (redistributable-license) repositories. Each instance ships its own Dockerfile and eval_script, plus the gold patch and test_patch. Grading is rule-based via the OPENSWE_EXIT_CODE marker rather than FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS (which are empty).

Repositories that cannot be redistributed. Only the Dockerfile and eval_script are provided; the gold patch and a separate test_patch field are NOT released, so oracle solutions cannot be verified and the test patch must be kept inside the eval_script.

harbor_adapter.notes: Each task is self-contained: the openswe-python-X.Y base image is inlined as continuumio/miniconda3 + a testbed conda env (matching scripts/prepare_baseimg.py), and the build context's repo/ is cloned at base_commit. test.sh applies only the released test_patch on top of the agent's edits, then runs the eval body (with all inline patch heredocs stripped) and converts OPENSWE_EXIT_CODE into a reward.

Eval-only / best-effort: no gold patch is available, so no oracle solution is generated. The eval body keeps test-patch heredocs and strips only those whose surrounding comments mark them as the gold/fix patch.
